descriptionHtml:
Suggestion A1 · accessibility · not counted as a bug (was P2): accessibility is not asked for by any UAT item or ticket, so this is a suggestion, not a bug (Quinn 2026-10-14)

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-22/S20

Approach · TC-21 Hospital vs. Nursing-Home Context Switch · S20 axe scan of both lists and both charts' Pre-Round and Encounter tabs

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U5 No Clinic anywhere: absent from the context switcher and from the template picker (UAT TC-21; TFA-92599 AC 4; TFA-92599 AC 9) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U2 Template list: Hospital offers exactly H&P, SOAP progress, Consult note and Discharge summary; Nursing Home offers exactly SNF admission, SNF follow-up, SNF consult and SNF discharge (not the prototy … (UAT TC-21; UAT TC-21 step 1 (template list); TFA-92599 AC 1) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress
  • U1e Quick Dictation is available in Hospital and absent in Nursing Home (UAT TC-21 step 1; UAT TC-04) — gate: blocked: TFA-92599 in progress

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given visual-lane fixture, desktop Chrome, Pixel 7 and iPhone 15 (WebKit)

When visual-lane.ts opens /rounding, /snf, both charts' Pre-Round and Encounter tabs (closed Note Format select) and the NH handoff, and runs axe

Then No WCAG 2 A/AA violations; the switcher buttons have accessible names

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): axe-core WCAG 2 A/AA findings from visual-checks.ts, reported for a human (report.mjs / to-allure 'needs-human'), not Pass/Fail

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (automated)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-21.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row; the Allure status was changed by the triage from passed to failed.

Issue type: Accessibility · environment local · tickets TFA-92599 in progress

On the Nursing Home screens the '+', Settings and back buttons have no accessible name, the Hospital patient card nests buttons inside a button, and text contrast fails AA on every list and chart screen.

Evidence: allure-results/15254a57…: the report shows passed because the oracle makes axe record-only, but the result carries axe findings: a critical button-name violation on the NH header '+' / Settings / back, a serious nested-interactive violation on the Hospital card, and AA contrast failures on every screen. An EFS risk predicted the unnamed NH buttons. It is included here even though it is not non-pass.

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

[2026-10-14 review] Record-only (oracle: 'reported for a human … not Pass/Fail'); the switcher-name check is kept as an unjudged value. ai/assist:generateHandoff is answered 'ok' at the socket (as OAT-06/S24b does) so the NH handoff under axe is the normal screen, not the 'couldn't be generated' fallback.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: record-only (oracle: axe findings reported for a human, not Pass/Fail). Then-clause checks evaluated, not judged: 6 held, 0 did not. Record-only per the oracle ('reported for a human … not Pass/Fail'). The context switcher buttons are named 'Hospital' and 'Nursing Home' (then-clause check held, not judged). The NH handoff is now captured with ai/assist:generateHandoff answered 'ok' at the socket, so axe sees the normal handoff screen. axe findings on the lists, both charts and the NH handoff are recorded for a person: contrast on every screen, NH '+'/Settings/back unnamed (button-name, critical), Hospital card nested-interactive (serious).

Product issue: Routed for a person (record-only): the axe findings above — critical button-name on the NH header '+' / Settings / back, serious nested-interactive on the Hospital card, AA contrast on every screen (then: 'No WCAG 2 A/AA violations').

Evidence: 9 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-21_S20 — a folder (45 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (Quinn 2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
